public_rationale: The available filing supplies useful expense data for Anthropic, but it cannot establish the 70% share or the funding chain. The linked reasoning does not independently establish an industry-wide denominator. Neither the nearby first-quarter figures nor the words 'I estimate' justify imposing a particular spending or accounting convention. Those missing definitions and comparable records prevent a fair verdict.
limitations: The historical filing covers one lab and a different reporting interval.
Unknown accounting basis prevents a supported or contradicted financial verdict.
Failure to establish the estimate is not evidence that it is false.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: He estimates that at least 70% of the entire AI industry's revenue is OpenAI and Anthropic's compute spend, and because both are horrendously unprofitable, the AI industry is, for the most part, venture capitalists funnelling money to hyperscalers, who funnel it to NVIDIA or data center capex.

statement.excerpt: I estimate that at least 70% of the entire AI industry’s revenues are made up of OpenAI and Anthropic’s compute spend, and as both companies are horrendously unprofitable, this means that the AI industry is, for the most part, venture capitalists funnelling money to hyperscalers so that they can funnel that money to NVIDIA or data center capex.

from_speaker: venture capitalists funnelling money to hyperscalers
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that the two labs' compute spending accounts for at least 70% of current AI-sector revenue, with outside investment financing most of this spending chain.

Assess the current position on July 7 using the latest revenue, spending and funding information then reportable. The nearby first-quarter figures do not restrict the entire assertion to that quarter.

Do not silently choose between payments, recognised expenses, annual spending projections and contractual commitments. Identify the convention underlying the estimate and compare like periods and measures.
Calling the calculation an estimate does not identify an accounting basis. The contract therefore records that basis as unknown.
The funding-flow explanation requires evidence beyond the two companies making losses.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable figures establish a share of at least 70% for the stated industry, both labs have substantial losses on an identified basis, and funding records establish that investor-financed compute purchases account for most of the described revenue chain.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable figures establish a share below 70%, or financial and funding records materially disprove the asserted loss-dependent funding chain. A result obtained only by selecting an unstated industry boundary or spending convention is insufficient.
